info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the Subscription Billing Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032). Drafts, edits and activates a Plan, subscribes a tenant (TRIALING), asserts entitlement/evaluate for a limit, an unlimited feature, a feature the plan leaves out, a plan change, a PAST_DUE grace period and a SUSPENDED subscription, walks the Subscription lifecycle (activate, mark-past-due, suspend, cancel) and reads both audit ledgers; negative cases cover validation, the plan lifecycle rules, "one current subscription per organisation", plans that are not on sale, tenant isolation and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. Plans are platform-wide, so every run drafts its own plan codes; subscriptions use their own generated tenant id (billingOrganisationId), so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
info.name: Subscription Billing Service - Plans, Subscriptions and Entitlements Suite

exec: pm.test('Liveness status is UP or UNKNOWN (no probe contributors registered)', () => pm.expect(['UP', 'UNKNOWN']).to.include(pm.response.json().status));
pm.test('Same plan', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('planId')); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('DRAFT'); });

pm.test('Contains our draft plan with the edit', () => { const ours = json.find(p => p.id === pm.environment.get('planId')); pm.expect(ours).to.exist; pm.expect(ours.name).to.eql('Team edition v2'); pm.expect(ours.entitlements.reports).to.eql(1); });

pm.test('Allowed up to 500, decided by the subscription', () => { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.limit).to.eql(500); pm.expect(json.source).to.eql('SUBSCRIPTION'); pm.expect(json.planCode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('planCode')); });

item.name: 09. Evaluate entitlement (a limit from the subscription plan)

exec: pm.test('Unlimited means allowed with no limit', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.allowed).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.limit == null).to.be.true; });

item.name: 10. Evaluate entitlement (unlimited, and a feature the plan does not include)
11. Evaluate entitlement (a feature set to 0 is not included)

exec: pm.test('SSO is in the Enterprise plan', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.allowed).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.planCode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('planCode2')); });

item.name: 16. Evaluate entitlement (now decided by the new plan)
18. Evaluate entitlement (PAST_DUE is a grace period)

exec: pm.test('Every act is on the ledger, in order', () => { pm.expect(json.map(e => e.action)).to.eql(['INITIATED', 'STATUS_CHANGED', 'PLAN_CHANGED', 'STATUS_CHANGED', 'STATUS_CHANGED', 'STATUS_CHANGED']); pm.expect(json[0].fromStatus == null).to.be.true; });
pm.test('The cancelled one is history', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(json[0].id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('subscriptionId')); });
pm.test('Not decided by a subscription', () => pm.expect(['DEFAULT_PLAN', 'UNMANAGED']).to.include(pm.response.json().source));

item.name: 26. Evaluate entitlement (without a subscription the default plan, or nothing, stands in)
06. Update Plan - An ACTIVE plan cannot be edited (409)
07. Control: Activate Plan - An ACTIVE plan is not a DRAFT (409)
08. Control: Retire Plan - A RETIRED plan cannot be retired again (409)
11. Initiate Subscription - A RETIRED plan is not on sale (409)
12. Initiate Subscription - A plan that does not exist (409)
14. Initiate Subscription (allowed again once the previous one was cancelled)
15. Initiate Subscription - One current subscription per organisation (409)
16. Update Subscription plan - To the plan it is already on (409)
17. Control: Mark past due - A TRIALING subscription is not ACTIVE (409)
18. Control: Activate - A CANCELLED subscription is terminal (409)
19. Retrieve Subscription - Another tenant's subscription answers like a missing one (404)
20. Control: Cancel - Another tenant cannot cancel it (404)
21. Retrieve current Subscription - A tenant with none (404)
24. Delete - There is no DELETE (404 or 405)
25. Control: Cancel the second Subscription (clean up)
